text: Who is the student's best critic?
zh: 谁是这位学生最严厉的批评者？
zh_hant: 誰是這位學生最嚴厲的批評者？

text: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures.
zh: 我是一名美术学生，画了很多画。
zh_hant: 我是一名美術學生，畫了很多畫。

text: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.
zh: 很多人假装他们懂现代艺术。
zh_hant: 很多人假裝他們懂現代藝術。

text: They always tell you what a picture is 'about'.
zh: 他们总是告诉你一幅画是“关于”什么的。
zh_hant: 他們總是告訴你一幅畫是“關於”什麼的。

text: Of course, many pictures are not 'about' anything.
zh: 当然，很多画根本“不关于”任何东西。
zh_hant: 當然，很多畫根本“不關於”任何東西。

text: They are just pretty patterns.
We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
zh: 我们喜欢它们，就像喜欢漂亮的窗帘布一样。
zh_hant: 我們喜歡它們，就像喜歡漂亮的窗簾布一樣。

text: I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures
zh: 我觉得小孩子往往比其他人更能欣赏现代画，
zh_hant: 我覺得小孩子往往比其他人更能欣賞現代畫，

text: better than anyone else.
They notice more.
My sister is only seven,
but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
zh: 但她总是告诉我我的画好不好。
zh_hant: 但她總是告訴我我的畫好不好。

text: She came into my room yesterday.
'What are you doing?'
she asked.
'I'm hanging this picture on the wall,' I answered.
zh: “我把这幅画挂到墙上，”我回答。
zh_hant: “我把這幅畫掛到牆上，”我回答。

text: 'It's a new one.
Do you like it?'
She looked at it critically for a moment.
'It's all right,'
she said, 'but isn't it upside down?'
zh: 她说，“但这不是挂反了吗？”
zh_hant: 她說，“但這不是掛反了嗎？”

text: I looked at it again.
She was right!
It was!
